spans.s:
mf. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा)
The tinkling sound of silver and other metallic ornaments worn round the waist, arm, or ancles, &c.
f. (-ञ्जा)
A bow string.
E.
शिजि to make an inarticulate sound, aff. अङ् and टाप्: also शिञ्जिनी, &c.

f. (-ञ्जा)
The sound of metallic ornaments, jingling, ringing, tinkling; more usually शिञ्जा, q. v.

f. (-का)
A chain worn round a man's loins.

n. (-तं)
The tinkling of metallic ornaments worn as rings, chains, &c.
E.
शिञ्जा inarticulate sound, इतच् aff.

mfn. (-ञ्जी-ञ्जिनी-ञ्जि)
Tinkling, making a tinkling sound.
f. (-ञ्जिनी)
1 A bow-string.
2 Metallic rings worn round the toes, an ornament of the feet.
E.
शिञ्जा a tinkling, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-ञ्चन्-ञ्चन्ती-ञ्चत्)
Sprinkling, throwing water.
E.
षिच to sprinkle, शतृ aff. of the present participle.
